messages:
Jordan: Quick design review request — proposing we regroup the left rail into three collapsible clusters: Project (overview, settings), Models (catalog, versions), and Serving (endpoints, traffic, logs). Thinking this reduces noise for new users and surfaces the things teams actually click most. Thoughts?

Sara: love the idea. can we keep a lightweight breadcrumb above the page so deep-links still feel discoverable? e.g. Project > Models > model-name — users should be able to copy a link and land on the same UI state. :link:

Mike: agree re deep links. curious about how we encode the collapsed state though. do we want group open/closed in the URL? hash? session-only?

Jordan: good Q. proposal: include persistent permalinks that capture the exact route (project/model) but not every ephemeral collapse state. for transient UI (expanded/collapsed) use local state + a short hash fragment when user explicitly copies "Copy link". e.g. `/console/p/abc/models/mdl-123#rail=collapsed(project,serving)`

Katie: from accessibility POV we should ensure keyboard focus lands on the primary content after deep-linking. also add `aria-current` on the selected item and a visible focus ring on nav items. small copy tweak: change "Models" label to "Model catalog" — slightly clearer for non-ML folks.

Mike: engineering note: React Router v6 handles nested routes fine, but watch out for using query params for UI state. query params are great for filters, but mixing collapse UI in query string makes back button noisy. I like Jordan's hash-fragment idea for explicit share intent.

Sara: +1 for keeping back button sane. also want to call out mobile: collapsible clusters should be accordion-like (single-column) and deep links should expand the matching group on load.

Jordan: implementation nit: when route is `/console/p/:pid/models/:mid` server-side rendering should return the page skeleton and client can call `history.replaceState` after expanding the right group so we don't add extra history entries. pseudo: 
```js
// on mount if deep link -> expand group, then
history.replaceState(null, '', routeWithoutHash)
```

Mike: sounds doable. we should add tests: keyboard nav (tab order), screen reader announce when group expands (use `aria-live="polite"`), and permalink copying behavior.

Katie: tiny copy suggestion for the breadcrumb: use full words, not chevrons-only. e.g. "Projects / MyCorp / Models / gpt-small" — it helps screen reader clarity.

design-bot: FYI — adding this thread to the "nav-ia" board and tagging `#ux-review`. Reminder: RFC for routing changes needs a short migration plan for existing bookmarked URLs.

Jordan: thanks all. i'll put together a quick mock with the cluster states + permalink copy flow and share tomorrow. tagging @Sara for breadcrumb microcopy and @Mike for a short engineering approach section. :thumbsup:
